{{Quote|Name: Marcovic. Rank: Lieutenant. That's all you're getting from me, Jedi scum.|Lieutenant Marcovic|<ref name="New Intelligence" />}}
'''Marcovic''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. A [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]], Marcovic was assigned to a secret [[Imperial Listening Post|listening post]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] in the later [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the Cold War. During the early [[Standard day/Legends|days]] of [[Darth Angral]]'s [[Desolator crisis|campaign of vengeance]] for the [[Duel in the Jedi Temple ruins|death]] of his [[Tarnis (Sith Lord)|son]] where the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] seized control of Republic [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapons]] and turned them against the Republic, the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] traced a [[Hologram/Legends|holotransmission]] of Angral's back to Ord Mantell, but lost the signal beyond that point. In an attempt to gather information on Angral's plans, the Republic [[General/Legends|General]] [[Var Suthra]] sent a [[Hero of Tython|young Jedi Knight]] and the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[T7-O1]] on a [[Mission to Ord Mantell (Desolator crisis)|mission]] to the base, where the two stormed the facility and [[Slicer/Legends|hacked]] into their records. Loyal to the Empire even in the face of [[Death/Legends|death]], Marcovic sacrificed his life to destroy the facility's [[Subspace transceiver/Legends|subspace transceiver]] in an attempt to stop the Knight from retrieving the data.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Copy every file you can, Teeseven. We need to know what this Desolator weapon can do.''"<br />"''You won't live long enough to tell anyone.|The Hero gives orders to T7-O1, causing Marcovic to attack the droid|<ref name="New Intelligence" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], Marcovic enlisted in the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|military]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], and he had risen to the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]]<ref name="New Intelligence" /> by the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3643 BBY]].<ref name="Time" /> He was eventually assigned to an [[Imperial Listening Post|listening post]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]],<ref name="New Intelligence" /> where the facility's personnel gathered intelligence on Republic [[Troop/Legends|troop]] movements.<ref name="Listening Post">{{TORcite|type=codex|Imperial Listening Post (Knight)}}</ref> In 3,643 BBY,<ref name="Time" /> the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Angral]] contacted his son [[Tarnis (Sith Lord)|Tarnis]] on the Republic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], as well as his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentices]] [[Praven]], [[Nefarid]], and [[Sadic]] on other worlds.<ref name="Race to the Ruins">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Race to the Ruins|Coruscant}}</ref> To secure his transmission, Angral ran it through several planets, including the Imperial outpost on Ord Mantell.<ref name="New Intelligence" />

However, when Angral witnessed his son's [[Duel in the Jedi Temple ruins|death]] at the hands of a [[Hero of Tython|Jedi Knight]], he began to issue declarations of war against the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the Republic, seizing control of Republic [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapons]] in his [[Desolator crisis|crusade]].<ref name="Race to the Ruins" /> The [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] (SIS), the Republic's intelligence agency, was able to trace Angral's [[Hologram/Legends|holotransmission]] back to Ord Mantell but lost it beyond that point.<ref name="New Intelligence" /> Angral's apprentices had used information gathered by Tarnis, who had been operating undercover as a Republic [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]], to seize control of several Republic superweapon projects,<ref name="Race to the Ruins" /> and [[General/Legends|General]] [[Var Suthra]] of the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] sent the young [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who had killed Tarnis to investigate the Ord Mantell facility and figure out Angral's plans. Accompanied by the [[T7-series astromech droid|astromech droid]] [[T7-O1]], the Jedi located and [[Mission to Ord Mantell (Desolator crisis)|attacked]] the base while Marcovic was stationed in the lower levels of the complex.<ref name="New Intelligence" />

{{GameLS}}
[[File:Marcovic_and_T7.png|thumb|right|180px|Marcovic and T7-O1]]
Marcovic prepared to defend the Imperial compound along with the other Imperial [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] and [[Officer/Legends|officers]] stationed in the facility, and the Lieutenant was the only defender left by the time the two attackers reached the listening post's hyperspace [[Subspace transceiver/Legends|transceiver]]. The Human officer attempted to defend the transceiver with his life, battling the Knight and the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] with his [[Vibrosword/Legends|vibrosword]], but he was ultimately no match for the Knight's combat prowess and the Jedi severely injured the Lieutenant. Determined to give his enemy nothing, Marcovic refused to say anything beyond his name and rank until he realized that the Jedi's [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] was attempting to access the facility's records. In a last-ditch attempt to stop the enemies of the Empire, the Lieutenant threw himself at the droid in a [[Death/Legends|suicidal]] attack and destroyed the transceiver before he was cut down by the Knight's [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].<ref name="New Intelligence" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|I didn't want to kill him. He gave me no choice.''"<br />"''Imperial organics <nowiki>=</nowiki> not logical|The Jedi and T7-O1 discuss Marcovic|<ref name="New Intelligence" />}}
A fair-skinned Human male with [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], Marcovic had black [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and a small mustache. Marcovic was a proud individual and fiercely loyal to the Empire, and he despised the Jedi as symbols of the Republic. Even when fatally wounded, he refused to submit to possible questioning, only giving his rank and name to the Jedi. He then attacked T7-O1 when the astromech attempted to access the listening post's records in a last, suicidal attempt to protect the Empire. Unlike the rest of the soldiers stationed at the listening post, Marcovic preferred to wield a vibrosword in combat instead of a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]].<ref name="New Intelligence" />

==Behind the scenes==
Marcovic appears in the [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', as part of the Jedi Knight class storyline. He is the final boss in the Imperial Listening Post, as part of the "New Intelligence" mission on Ord Mantell. Once the player eliminates almost all of his health, a conversation with Marcovic is initiated and the player has the option to ask him to surrender, ignore him or kill him for [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] points. The first two options do not result in alignment points, but Marcovic will attack the player after he realizes that T7-O1 is attempting to hack the facility's computers, and he will be killed regardless.<ref name="New Intelligence" />
